Sam: Quick floor briefing — short updates and three asks for the week.
Sam: TL;DR: Private GA target ~4/21 (soft launch with 5 pilot customers), cost target -10% per token via batching+quant configs, temporary EU data-retention policy change (90-day logs) while legal completes review, and a two-week watch on 95th pct latency after the new quant build.
Maya: Noted. I'll prepare the GA one-pager and a 3-bullet sales summary tonight. Who owns the KMS/HSM integration note for the docs?

Ana: Reliability watch: we saw a +12% bump in 95th for embeddings during the last quant experiment. Setting alerts and a dedicated oncall for the rollout window. If it trends up I'll post a short incident review.
Priya: Sales ask: three customers requested early access and contract language around data residency. I'll share the list and templates by EOD. Also need the sales one-pager from Maya.
Sam: Assigning: Maya -> sales one-pager & GA docs; Leon -> rollout & KMS/HSM note; Ana -> SLO/watch; Priya -> customer coordination + contracts. Two explicit asks: 1) Maya: 3-bullet Sales note by EOD. 2) Leon: perf delta + cost model showing expected -10% token cost from batching/quant by Wed.
